chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from his father, from Sa'dan ibn Muslim, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), who said:
Your providing for the breaking of the fast of your fasting brother is superior to your own fast.

key_terms.أَفْضَل: More virtuous, superior, carrying greater merit or reward
key_terms.صَائِم: One who is fasting; a fasting person
key_terms.صِيَام: The fast itself; the act of fasting
key_terms.فِطْر: The act of breaking the fast; also used to denote providing food for someone to break their fast

ai.seo_question: Is feeding a fasting person more rewarding than fasting oneself in Islam?
ai.summary: Your providing for the breaking of the fast of your fasting brother is superior to your own fast.
word_analysis: your providing for the breaking of the fast
